note: the floor: CI fails if the everyday benchmark scores lower. Raise it when Void answers more; never lower it. latency: p95 of the wait for an answer, one baseline per environment (local, ci). A run with misses whose p95 is over max(1.5x, +100ms) of its baseline is inconclusive (machine under load): it changes nothing and is re-run alone. The baseline only tightens, and only from a conclusive run at or above the floor on a quiet machine (tools/bench-floor.mjs); with no baseline for an environment a run is conclusive and the first clean run records it.
